notes.title: xd1 is out
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216371/0d0da986b80c5144e0a068b6eb437dbe27caac33.jpg"][/img][i]Illustration: Абу Ланодий Д[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216371/4111374e3dc2d34bf85d76e3150aa995153d82db.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="687"][tr][th colwidth="687"][p]xd1 is still out in early access![/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="687"][p]Thanks to the animatronics for waiting. We tried so hard for all of you who wanted the game and waited for a long time! Early access, however, the Dubai programmers did not have time to finish everything that was planned. But don't be sad, animatronics, we'll still have time![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216371/02a52c3f7075b2a1c5ba360f83974c2dfa15106e.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][table equalcells="1" colwidth="687"][tr][th colwidth="687"][p]FAQ about early access[/p][/th][/tr][/table][table equalcells="1" colwidth="344,"][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Questionable[/p][/th][th][p]Answerable[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Why Early Access?[/p][/td][td][p][i]“Everything is so early access, supposedly sad but better in terms of the final! Right now, as soon as we finish everything, as soon as we show everyone... Our goal is to make the game so better that it would be enjoyable to play! Everything is still so simple, we haven't managed to finish both chapters by the release...”[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/p][/td][td][p][i]“The second chapters are not yet fully completed. Everything is so ambiguous, but maybe everything will sit like this until the summer of 2026.”[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/p][/td][td][p][i]“We plan to finish the first and second chapters completely and the canon ending. Also, additional mechanics, fixes for bugs found by people and many Dubai secrets!”[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/p][/td][td][p][i]"Everything is so, the second chapter has only the first part, that is, now the second chapters are not fully available and break off at the first parts, the game still does not have an ending. The first chapters of the game are also still so unfinished, there are not enough details, we will add later, in the future!"[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/p][/td][td][p][i]“The price never changes for the first and second chapters - everything is so free forever. Want to support? Buying the soundtrack is not a shame!”[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/p][/td][td][p][i]“Every player can help! Whether it's writing stuff in the Steam community or reporting bugs via email, we take everything into account. Don't be shy, animatronics, write all your ideas!”[/i][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][i]Play, test, report any issues you find and have fun playing the game![/i][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Progress at release time![/p][/th][/tr][/table][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Chapter 1[/p][/th][th][p]Chapter 2[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]80%[/b] finished! let's add some more stuff![/p][/td][td][p]it's still only about [b]25%[/b]... a lot is needed..[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b][i]You can still support the game like this:[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]buying OSTs of great,[/p][/*][*][p]reporting bugs and tell your opinions,[/p][/*][*][p]and also just to spread the word about the game so that more animatronics would know about it![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your understanding and patience.[/p]
